nodes.text: INSTANT · ON-DEVICE AI This file is a compilation of provisions from the United States Constitution , specifically covering the legislative and executive branches. Its main points are: • Legislative Branch (House): Members serve two-year terms; revenue bills originate here, with Senate amendments possible on other bills. • Executive Branch: The President signs bills introduced by Congress and acts as a veto if they fail to return within ten days. Bills requiring both House approvals must pass a 2/3 majority of each house. • Elections: Senators are chosen every second year (10-year terms). • Vice Presidency: The President can appoint or choose a Vice President if two or more electors have equal votes. • Constitutional Rights & Powers: • Treason is defined under strict legal requirements involving witnesses in open court; only convicted persons can be punished for it. • Congress has the power to declare treason but cannot use "Attainder" to cause corruption of blood or forfeiture unless the individual remains alive. • New States may only join Congress if three-fourths of their states consent; new states cannot form through junctions without that same consent.
